line: Person: a man about fifty, a weathered square brow, thick bushy grizzled grey eyebrows, deep crow's-feet around narrowed light brown eyes, a pale burn mark across the left temple, ash-grey skin, the scarf pulled up over the nose and mouth so only the eyes and brows show. Kit: a low close-fitting hood pulled down to the eyebrows and joined to a short shoulder cape of smoke-grey wool; a soot-black scarf with a frayed edge wound high around the face; a light leather jerkin with no metal plates and no medallion; a plain leather strap across the chest.

Person: a man about sixty-five, a gaunt bony face, white bristling eyebrows, the left eye milky and crossed by an old scar while the right eye is sharp, a soot-blackened forehead, the long scarf wound up over the nose and mouth and knotted at the side of the head with the ends hanging down. Kit: a tattered low hood tied around the brow with a twisted cord; a long faded smoke-grey scarf; a heavy iron toggle clasp; a light cracked-leather jerkin with no metal plates.

Person: a man about thirty, a broad flat face, heavy brows, black tattoos of flame tongues rising up both cheekbones to the temples, alert brown eyes, the scarf pulled up over the mouth and chin with the nose left bare. Kit: a short close-fitting hood that hugs the head; a thick charcoal scarf wound around the neck and lower face; a light padded charcoal jerkin with leather straps; no spaulders, no metal plates, no medallion.

Person: a man about seventy, a round fleshy face, heavy jowls, clean-shaven, a flattened broken nose, deep pouches under the eyes, ash-grey skin mottled with darker soot stains, a row of small raised ritual scar dots across the forehead, a shrewd heavy-lidded look. Kit: a tall stiff peaked cowl rising straight up to a sharp point, its seams stiffened with thin iron ribs so it cannot droop, the whole cowl and its tip inside the frame with dark space above it; a broad mantle of layered smoke-grey cloth with a ragged hem; a pendant of a rough black iron ingot on a chain.

Person: a man of about sixty-five, a narrow ascetic face, a long hooked nose, a clean-shaven chin under a long thin grey moustache that hangs down past the jaw, deep-set eyes in dark hollows, weathered bark-brown skin, three thin dark tattooed lines down the chin, a remote stern look. Kit: a soft loose hood of faded olive-brown wool hanging in deep folds, with two very short antler nubs barely poking through the cloth above the brow; a collar of brown owl feathers; a clasp shaped like a crescent moon.

Person: a man of about eighty, a round face, a bushy white moustache and a short white beard with moss tufts, sallow lined fair skin, a kindly tired look. Kit: a hood made from a dun-brown deer hide with the short fur still on (no deer head, no ears), with two tiny rounded velvet-covered antler buds just above the brow and no tines; a clasp carved as a hare; a pendant of a grey stone with a hole through it.

Person: a young woman of about twenty-six, a broad square face with a strong jaw, straight black hair cut in a blunt line at the jaw with a short fringe, small dark eyes, pale olive skin, a thin dark vine tattoo running up the side of the neck, a calm level look. Kit: a circlet of dark yew twigs with short flat needles; a clasp of carved bone shaped like a snail shell; the moss-green hood thrown back onto the shoulders.

Person: a young man of about twenty-four, a broad heavy face with full cheeks, a shaved scalp with dark stubble, a short thick black beard, small light brown eyes, tan skin, a crescent of small dot tattoos at the outer corner of each eye, a quiet amused look. Kit: a circlet of grey ash twigs with black buds sitting on the bare scalp; a clasp of a carved wooden ring; the cloak with a frayed hem.

Person: a young man of about nineteen, a long narrow face with a straight nose and a firm jaw, close-cropped tightly curled black hair, a faint first moustache, wide dark-brown eyes, warm umber skin, a smudge of earth on one cheek, an alert eager look. Kit: a circlet of oak twigs with tiny acorns; the cloak pinned with a plain bronze ring; a leather pouch strap over the shoulder.

Person: a young man about nineteen, a thin narrow face with a sharp jaw and prominent cheekbones, short messy black hair, a first shadow of dark stubble on the upper lip and chin, a light soot smudge on the nose, eager wide grey eyes. Kit: a plain thin circlet; the robe with a high stiff collar; a small round iron button clasp; a plain cord belt.

Creature: a treant only a century old; the face is formed in a thick knotted trunk of grey-green alder bark furred with moss, not a human face: no human nose and no lips, a broad brow ridge of bark, a low rounded bulge of bark where a nose would be, a mouth that is only a dark crooked split low in the trunk, a quiet watchful look. Eyes: two small dark knotholes, hollow and shadowed, with no whites, no irises and no eyeballs. Marks: a low crown of short thick budding twigs with a few small pale-green leaves; curled young fern fronds growing from the moss on the shoulders; no beard.

Creature: an ancient treant, the face formed in a broad stump-like trunk of deeply furrowed dark oak bark, not a human face: a heavy overhanging brow of bark, a broad burl for a nose, a mouth that is a long dark crack half hidden in hanging grey beard-lichen and moss, a slow grave look. Eyes: two deep dark knotholes under the brow, hollow and shadowed, with no whites, no irises, no eyelids and no eyeballs. Marks: a wide crown of thick gnarled oak branches, one broken off to a jagged stump; shelf fungus on the shoulder.

Creature: a salamander in its early strength, a broad flat heavy head like a giant river salamander turned three-quarters toward the right (not in profile), a wide lipless mouth, a thick neck with loose folds of skin, dull obsidian-black scales with a fine net of dull ember-orange cracks, small deep-set dark eyes with no glow and no shine, a wary stubborn look, the head set lower in the frame with the eyes a little above the middle. Marks: a row of short stubby horn nubs along each side of the jaw, three blunt bony knobs on the brow, a pale healed scrape across the snout.

Person: a man about forty, a lean long face, light brown skin, black hair shaved short at the sides, a neat narrow black chin beard with no moustache, heavy-lidded dark eyes, a pitted pockmarked cheek, a dry patient look. Kit: a tall pear-shaped iron cap rising to a small stalk at the top, with a narrow flat brim all round, like a cabasset; a padded jerkin of faded charcoal-brown wool with a stiff standing collar; a leather pouch strap across the chest.

Person: a man of about twenty-eight, a round face, curly black hair, a thin black beard along the jaw, warm brown skin, three thin green dots painted on the forehead and a green stripe down the chin, an eager look. Kit: a hood of overlapping heart-shaped linden leaves in muted dull olive and dry tan, each leaf clearly a leaf with a stem and veins, not scales; a twine-wrapped leather collar; a clasp of a smooth grey river stone.

Person: a woman about thirty, a long angular face, high cheekbones, weathered pale skin with an even muted tone and no red on the cheeks, light grey eyes, dark blonde hair in two thick braids falling from under the helm, a thin scar across the bridge of the nose, a hard determined look. Kit: a rounded iron skullcap helm with two hinged cheek plates, a deep dent above the brow; a mantle of thick brown bear fur fastened with a carved bone toggle.

Person: a young man about nineteen, a soft round face, light brown skin with an even muted tone and no red on the cheeks, dark brown eyes, black hair cut short at the neck, a faint first moustache, a small scar through one eyebrow, a sharp watchful look. Kit: a simple open iron helm with a plate guarding the back of the neck and two dents on the crown, a wool scarf wound at the throat; a mantle of long-haired cream-white goatskin, fastened with a twisted iron clasp.

Person: a woman about forty-five, a broad weathered face, muted weathered light-brown skin (dull and earthy, not orange or golden), dark almond-shaped eyes, black hair in a thick knot at the nape held by a bone pin, deep lines around the mouth, a calm watchful look. Kit: a short conical leather cap stitched from four panels and ending in a small knot at the top, no brim and no peak, the ears uncovered; a cloak of sedge woven in a checker pattern of pale and dark reeds; a clasp of braided eel-skin cord.
